rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for framing something as being done in the traditional manner.

example.english: Traditionally, people eat rice cakes during Lunar New Year.
example.jyutping: cyun4 tung2 soeng6 gwo3 nin4 jiu3 sik6 nin4 gou1

rows.note: Use this when the action follows an established traditional practice or procedure.

example.english: We traditionally follow the established practice of eating only after worshipping the gods.
example.traditional: 我哋照傳統做法，拜完神先食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ziu3 cyun4 tung2 zou6 faat3 baai3 jyun4 san4 sin1 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on using old-style methods or techniques.

example.english: At this shop, we traditionally make tofu using old-style methods.
example.traditional: 呢間舖用傳統方法整豆腐。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 jung6 cyun4 tung2 fong1 faat3 zing2 dau6 fu6
